backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with user data models and in-memory maps for tasks, notes, profiles, timers, rewards, and other app state.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence for profile photo removal and header avatar updates, including file references, components, tests, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries for various frontend components and utilities in the project.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file setting up metadata, icons, and loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component handling authentication flow, background persistence, and rendering the tab‑based dashboard.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundSettin: Background customization component supporting paid uploads, camera capture, and AI rarity‑tier backgrounds with coin deductions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying attribution text and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with theme toggle, authentication handling, and user avatar dropdown.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Landing and login screen displaying app features and triggering Internet Identity login.
frontend/src/components/NotesSection.tsx: Notes manager allowing creation, editing, deletion, and media uploads including images and voice notes.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSection.t: User profile page supporting editing profile info, avatar upload, display name changes, and level progression.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Initial profile setup dialog collecting name and bio and creating the user's profile.
frontend/src/components/ReminderNotifica: Background notifier that checks upcoming reminders and triggers notifications within one minute.
frontend/src/components/RemindersSection: UI for creating reminders with title, date, and time, and listing upcoming reminders retrieved from backend queries.
frontend/src/components/StopwatchSection: Persistent stopwatch component that restores state from backend, tracks elapsed time, and supports start, pause, and reset.
frontend/src/components/TimerSection.tsx: Pomodoro and custom timer with persistence, notifications, rewards, and session tracking including coins and streaks.
frontend/src/components/timetable/DoneTo: Checkbox that marks a timetable entry as completed for today using tick history and toggle mutation.
frontend/src/components/timetable/EditTi: Dialog component allowing users to edit a timetable entry’s title and activity type and save updates via mutation.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Dialog displaying a timetable entry’s last 6 months of completion data, including stats and daily history list.
frontend/src/components/TimetableSection: CRUD interface for daily timetable entries with types, colors, editing, deletion, and completion history dialogs.
frontend/src/components/TodoSection.tsx: Task manager allowing creation, listing, and completion of tasks with priority, subject, and description fields.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and utilities for managing Internet Identity login, stored identity, and auth client lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for profiles, coins, backgrounds, and other app data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables for light and dark modes and applying base styles.
frontend/src/lib/NotificationManager.ts: Utility class for showing toast notifications for timers and reminders and handling browser notification permissions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point configuring React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the main App.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrorMessage.t: Maps backend error strings to user-friendly messages for display in the UI.
frontend/src/utils/timetableDates.ts: Provides helpers to format dates as YYYY-MM-DD, convert bigint timestamps to date keys, and check if a timestamp corresponds to today.
frontend/src/utils/timetableHistory.ts: Generates date ranges and maps tick history to daily completion states for the last six months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based query params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, and container settings with plugins for typography, animations, and container queries.
project_state.json: Tracks the project’s feature plans, requirements, architectural notes, and known issues for the timetable app.
